function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a quick guide to the most popular styles, what they’re good for, and tips on choosing the right one for you. | Style | Description | Ideal Use | Key Features | |-------|-------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines the length of boxers with the snugness of briefs. | Everyday wear, gym, travel | • Full‑leg coverage
• Good support
• Usually made from cotton, modal, or blends | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑leg, snug fit that stays in place. | Work, casual, sports | • Tight waistband
• Minimal leg coverage
• Excellent support | | **Boxers** | Loose, breathable, long‑leg. | Sleep, lounging, light activities | • Loose fit
• Breathable cotton or bamboo
• Less support | | **Trunks** | Shorter than boxer briefs, similar snugness. | Athletic, fashion | • Shorter leg length
• Modern cut
• Often made from performance fabrics | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive front pouch with a waistband and optional leg straps. | Sports, high‑impact activities | • Targeted support
• Minimal coverage
• Usually made from spandex or nylon | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, supportive, often with a built‑in pouch. | Running, cycling, recovery | • Muscle support
• Moisture‑wicking
• Usually made from polyester blends | | **Bamboo/Modal** | Made from natural fibers, ultra‑soft. | Sensitive skin, eco‑friendly | • Hypoallergenic
• Breathable
• Sustainable | | **Performance Fabrics (Polyester/Spandex blends)** | Designed for moisture management and stretch. | Sports, hot climates | • Quick‑dry
• Anti‑odor
• Durable | | **Luxury/Designer** | Premium fabrics, unique cuts, often with branding. | Special occasions, gifts | • High‑quality cotton, silk, or cashmere blends
• Stylish details | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity (sleep, lounging):** Boxers or loose briefs. - **Moderate activity (work, light exercise):** Boxer briefs or trunks. - **High activity (sports, running, cycling):** Compression shorts or performance briefs. 2. **Think About Comfort & Fit** - **Waistband:** Should be snug but not tight. Look for a wide, flat waistband to avoid digging. - **Pouch:** A supportive pouch can reduce friction and improve comfort. - **Fabric:** Natural fibers (cotton, bamboo) are breathable; synthetic blends offer moisture control. 3. **Check the Fabric Blend** - **Cotton:** Soft, breathable, but can absorb sweat. - **Bamboo/Modal:** Ultra‑soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Polyester/Spandex:** Stretchy, quick‑dry, ideal for active wear. - **Silk/Cashmere:** Luxury feel, great for special occasions. 4. **Look for Quality Construction** - **Seams:** Flat seams reduce irritation. - **Y‑cut or T‑cut:** Provides better coverage and less bulk. - **Tagless labels:** Avoid itchy tags. 5. **Try Them On** - If possible, try different styles in a store or order a small assortment online to test fit and comfort. --- ## Top Brands & Recommendations | Brand | Best For | Notable Products | |-------|----------|------------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs & boxer briefs | CK 360° briefs, CK Boxer Briefs | | **Uniqlo** | Affordable, breathable | AIRism briefs, AIRism boxer briefs | | **Tommy John** | Comfort & durability | Second Skin briefs, Cool Dri boxer briefs | | **Saxx** | Innovative pouch design | Saxx Underwear, Saxx Boxer Briefs | | **Under Armour** | Performance fabrics | UA Tech briefs, UA HeatGear trunks | | **Lululemon** | Athletic compression | Lululemon Speedster shorts | | **MeUndies** | Soft, sustainable | Bamboo briefs, cotton boxer briefs | | **Hanes** | Budget-friendly | Classic briefs, boxer briefs | | **Bamboo Body** | Eco‑friendly | Bamboo briefs, bamboo boxer briefs | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **What’s the difference between boxer briefs and trunks?** | Trunks are shorter in leg length than boxer briefs, giving a more modern look while still providing support. | | **Do I need a pouch?** | A pouch offers support and reduces friction. If you’re prone to chafing, choose a style with a pouch. | | **Can I wear boxer briefs for sports?** | Yes, especially if they’re made from moisture‑wicking fabrics. For high‑impact sports, consider compression shorts or jockstraps. | | **How often should I replace underwear?** | Every 3–6 months, or sooner if you notice wear, loss of elasticity, or odor retention. | | **Is cotton good for hot climates?** | Cotton is breathable but can retain sweat. Look for cotton blends with moisture‑wicking properties or switch to bamboo/linen. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort:** Boxer briefs or classic briefs. - **For lounging or sleep:** Loose boxers or soft cotton briefs. - **For sports or high‑activity:** Performance briefs, trunks, or compression shorts. - **For sensitive skin or eco‑friendly choices:** Bamboo or modal fabrics. Try a few styles from reputable brands, pay attention to fit and fabric, and you’ll find the “best” underwear that feels like a second skin. Happy shopping!
